supplied.cycle: two-step walking cycle, mirror-symmetric legs; right touchdown at phase 0, double support [0, T_ds), right single support [T_ds, T), double support [T, T + T_ds), left single support [T + T_ds, 2T)
supplied.stride_choice: spec-derived (walk_ceiling): least predicted positive work per metre among the feasible (s, delta, hr) on the grid s 0.05..0.80 (0.025), delta 0.05..0.60 (0.05), hr 0.70..0.96 (6); T_ds >= pi x plant lag; single support >= 80 ms; utilisations <= 1 (stance: envelope; swing: KNEE_U of rating)
supplied.com: periodic LIPM, z_c = posture COM height, ZMP at the stance ankle in single support, linear ankle-to-ankle in double support (a sole-centre ZMP variant, WALK_ZMPSOLE=1, was tested on G1/H1 0.6 and not adopted)
supplied.reach: the scaffold lowers the predicted hip height (0.01 steps) until the stance ankle stays within 0.93 L of the hip (the predictor allows 0.97 L); recorded per stride (hr_predicted, reach_adjusted)
supplied.swing: world rest-to-rest quintic ankle path rear -> front foothold, sole bump 0.03 m x 64 s^3 (1-s)^3, level sole; numerical IK on the MJCF
supplied.arms: sprint angular-momentum counter-swing (cancels the fundamental of the legs' yaw momentum)
supplied.support: force control: DCM tracking through the CoP, p_cmd = p_ref + 2 (xi - xi_ref) (xi = c + v/omega), clipped to the loaded soles (share-weighted centres +- 70 % of the sole box); F_xy = M omega^2 (c - p_cmd) tilted by the attitude moment (M_x = h dF_y, M_y = -h dF_x); F_z = M (g + om_z^2 ez + 2 om_z dez); om_z = min(1/0.040, 0.5/lag); attitude moment I_c(-om_a^2 att - 2 om_a rate), om_a = 2 sqrt(g/z_c); commanded CoP inside 70 % of the sole; share by reference load x contact availability (load/0.15 Mg); per-sole CoP clip, |F_xy| <= 0.8 F_z, |M_z| <= 0.05 F_z
supplied.placement: foothold correction: d = (c - c_ref) + K_V (v - v_ref)/omega_LIPM (heading frame), K_V = (1.0 sagittal, 1.5 lateral), clipped +-0.15 m (x) / +-0.10 m (y), feet never closer than 0.5 x the nominal width, latched at 80 % swing
supplied.ds_contract: off (an opt-in hold at the end of double support until the new stance foot carries 30 % BW was tested on G1 and made it worse)
supplied.anchor: reference re-anchored at every touchdown on the landed foot (position, heading = turn reference at that event)
supplied.lag_comp: feedback on the state predicted one lag ahead (q + qd tau, c + v tau, attitude + rate tau); reference and feedforward advanced by the lag
supplied.tracker: PD per joint, omega 25 rad/s legs / 20 rad/s upper body (sprint's), zeta 1, locked-chain inertia; stance-leg PD x 0.1 under load
supplied.gains: SEARCHED controller-gain block g in [-1,1]^13 (g = 0 = the construction defaults): foothold velocity gains kvx = 1.0 x 2^g0, kvy = 1.5 x 2^g1; CoP DCM gain 2 x 2^g2; attitude bandwidth (2 x 2^g3) x omega_LIPM; CoP margin 0.7 + 0.2 g4; touchdown depth 0.02 x 2^g5 m; leg tracker bandwidth 25 x 2^(g6/2) rad/s; clock mode g7 > 0 = TIMED (fixed step timing, re-anchor at the scheduled event on the expected foot) else event-synchronised; g8 > 0 = stance hip-yaw PD at full gain; contact-share load 0.15 x 4^g9 of body weight (a stance foot takes its full reference share of the support force at this load); touchdown acceptance at 0.75 + 0.15 g10 of the swing (event clock); foothold-correction clip x 2^g11 (default +-0.15 m sagittal, +-0.10 m lateral); minimum foot separation (0.5 + 0.3 g12) x the nominal width. The defaults were set while debugging the G1 0.6 m/s prior (listed, not hidden); the search adapts them per robot and speed
supplied.knots: (frozen at 0 in the M5 searches unless WALK_KNOTS=1) sprint layout: 8 periodic torque knots per right-leg and right-arm joint (left mirrored half a cycle later), 4 per centre joint; amp 0.8..1.2 (step length), tscale 0.85..1.15, lean -0.25..0.25 rad (centred on the upright scaffold)
supplied.start: walking start at mid right single support, COM at the reference velocity, zero angular momentum about the COM
supplied.turn: heading reference ramps linearly by the turn angle over 5 strides starting after cycle 4; footholds rotate with the anchor heading; swing hip yaw lands the foot at the reference heading
supplied.lag: first-order actuator lag 10 ms (plant), torque-speed envelope with droop, back-EMF brake, OVERSPEED gate 1.1
supplied.ratings: published (min of MJCF peak, Unitree URDF effort and the vendor's published joint maximum (120.0, "unitree.com/g1 spec table, knee max torque G1 EDU 120 N.m; footnote [1]: largest joint motor's maximum"); a documented-rating choice, no hardware change)
supplied.contact: stock MJCF contact on every geom (STOCK_CONTACT=1; G1 solref 0.02 floor; H1 0.02)
supplied.solver: Newton, 50 iterations (project apply_dt; a DEPARTURE from the MJCFs' own settings, G1 5 and H1 100 iterations); control every physics step (1 ms and 0.5 ms)
supplied.tc_lag: the project lag TC_LAG = 40 ms (not the 10 ms plant lag) sets the support-height bandwidth cap om_z = min(1/0.040, 0.5/lag) and the scaffold feedforward's velocity smoothing window (0.5 x 40 ms)
supplied.friction_override: perturbation friction (mu) is applied to the floor AND every foot geom (repair round 2; before it, the floor-only override was a no-op because MuJoCo takes the max of the pair)
supplied.nominal: the plant's settled stance (branch_i settle); if that settle fell (H1 at stock contact), the MJCF keyframe with its lowest foot point on the floor (recorded per result)
supplied.held_joints: joints outside the driven set (G1: shoulder yaw, wrists; H1: shoulder yaw) are position servos kp = I_eff/dt^2 (project convention, dt-dependent)
supplied.gates: slip <= 0.02 m/stance, no flight >= 20 ms, double support >= 20 ms every step, 10 consecutive periodic strides (tolerances {'z': 0.02, 'pitch': 0.05, 'roll': 0.05, 'q': 0.08, 'qd': 1.5, 'vx': 0.1}), speed within +-5%, heading within 0.1 rad, no fall, no non-foot contact, overspeed <= 1.1, energy closure; both dt
